scope: Lattice full source suite after process ownership and bidirectional-input changes
admission: Local tests only; no model prompt, native tool action, or network route is authorized by this test invocation.
unit: One deterministic source-suite invocation; interruption retains live log and requires a new invocation identity, not a fabricated partial pass.
pass_action: Retain the source-suite observation; continue native/installed qualification separately.
fail_action: Preserve first failure; repair the implicated source or report an environment limitation before a successor run.
proof_limit: A green source suite is not native approval, authentication, installed recovery, or English corpus qualification.
